content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Music online

Selling music online using cryptocurrency eliminates dependency on conventional payment platforms that often charge high fees or impose restrictions. The architecture of sovereign digital commerce allows creators to maintain full ownership of their assets and profits. By utilizing tools like NOWPayments and Cloudflare, you can offer your music across multiple cryptocurrencies, enabling global access while minimizing transaction costs. This matters because it empowers artists to connect with their audience without intermediaries, ensuring that the majority of sales revenue goes directly into their pockets.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The backbone of selling music online without platforms like Stripe involves a combination of free tools and services. By deploying a stack that integrates GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, combined with Google Apps Script for backend logic, you streamline operations. NOWPayments facilitates cryptocurrency transactions, confirming payments with a low 0.5% fee. This architecture ensures that every aspect of your online store, from hosting to payment processing, is both efficient and scalable, allowing you to focus on creating instead of managing complex systems.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is designed specifically for digital creators in regions facing financial isolation. If you're a musician, course creator, or template designer in Nigeria, Ghana, or Zimbabwe, this solution is for you. By choosing to build on this architecture, you can bypass the limitations imposed by traditional payment services. This approach not only facilitates seamless transactions but also fosters a sense of sovereignty over your digital commerce operations, enabling you to thrive in a restrictive landscape.
Gumroad's 10% fee can eat into your profits significantly.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The key components of this digital commerce stack include hosting via GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, a backend powered by Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers, and payment processing through NOWPayments. These components work in unison to create a seamless user experience for both sellers and buyers. The integration of order storage through Supabase or Google Sheets supports easy management of your digital assets. With this setup, you retain complete ownership of your data and sales, ensuring that the platform does not dictate your success.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started selling music online with Bitcoin, first choose your hosting platform—GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, set up your backend logic using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to handle transactions. Integrate NOWPayments for accepting various cryptocurrencies. Store your orders using Supabase or Google Sheets, and implement automated delivery of your digital products. By following these steps, you'll be ready to launch your sovereign digital storefront without relying on conventional payment platforms.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, consider using a sovereign stack that integrates free tools for hosting and order management. NOWPayments allows you to accept cryptocurrency with minimal fees, ensuring you retain more of your profits. This approach eliminates reliance on traditional payment processors, giving you full control over your sales.
NOWPayments provides a straightforward, low-cost way to process crypto payments.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're interested in building your own digital download store that accepts crypto only, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197). This all-in-one solution equips you with everything needed to create and scale your online business. For more details, visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
Frequently Asked Questions
How can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?

You can create a digital storefront using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, and integrate payment processing through NOWPayments. This setup allows you to bypass traditional platforms and keep more of your profits.
What are the fees associated with selling music online using cryptocurrency?
NOWPayments charges just 0.5% on transactions, significantly lower than platforms like Gumroad, which charges 10%. This fee structure means you retain more revenue from each sale.
Can I automate the delivery of my digital products?

Yes, you can automate product delivery using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers. These tools can trigger file delivery immediately after payment confirmation, ensuring a seamless customer experience.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept for my music sales?
NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, allowing you to accept popular options like Bitcoin, Ethereum, and others, widening your potential customer base.
How do I maintain full ownership of my online store?
By using a sovereign stack built with tools like GitHub Pages and NOWPayments, you ensure that you own all data and infrastructure. Once deployed, no platform has access to your operations.
Owning your infrastructure means you control your revenue and customer relationships.
